connectBody: NIVO opens Facebook so you can allow it to read and answer the messages and comments of the Page you choose, and its linked Instagram account. You come back here to pick the Page.
connectScopes: NIVO asks to: list your Pages, read and answer Page and Instagram messages, read and answer comments, and read the leads of your lead ads. It never posts on its own.
devNote: Early access: while NIVO's Meta app is in development mode, only people who have a role on that app can connect a Page. Others will be able to once Meta approves the app.
notConfigured: NIVO has not turned on the Facebook integration yet. Please try again later.
authDenied: Facebook did not give access. Try again and allow every permission on the Facebook screen.
authFailed: Facebook did not accept the login. Please try again.
authExpired: That login took too long. Press Connect Facebook again.
authNoPages: Facebook did not list any Page that you manage. Log in again and tick the Page you want to connect.
authUnavailable: NIVO has not turned on the Facebook integration yet. Please try again later.
loggedIn: You are logged in. Pick the Page to connect.
pickBody: Pick the Facebook Page to connect. Its linked Instagram account comes with it.
pickNone: No Page is waiting. Go back and log in with Facebook.
pickNoIg: No Instagram account linked to this Page
pickSaved: The Page is connected and subscribed to messages, comments and leads.
testIntro: NIVO asks Meta what it will send to this connection.
testPageMissing: The Page is not yet subscribed to: {fields}.
testPageNone: The Page is not subscribed to NIVO's app.
testAppMissing: The Meta app's webhook for {object} still misses: {fields}.
testAppUrl: The Meta app's webhook for {object} points to another address ({url}).
testAppNone: The Meta app has no webhook for {object} yet.
testAppUnknown: Meta did not say how the app's webhook is set. In the Meta dashboard it should be: {url}.
testLocal: This NIVO is not on a public https address, so Meta cannot reach its webhook from here. Test it on the real site.
testNoVerify: The webhook verify token is not set on this NIVO.
testToken: Meta refused NIVO's access to this Page. Log in with Facebook again.
testAllGood: All set. Send a message to the Page, or comment under one of its posts, and it appears below.
testWaiting: Waiting for the first message or comment...
testSkipNote: The connection is saved. You can finish now; the first message will show in the list.
rowCheckOk: Meta delivers to this Page. It is subscribed to: {fields}.
rowCheckBad: Meta is not delivering to this Page yet. Open the connection and run Check the webhook.
errNotConfigured: The Facebook integration is not set up on this NIVO yet. Please try again later.
errPageGone: That Page is no longer in your list. Log in with Facebook again.
errPageInUse: This Page (or its Instagram account) is already connected in another connection.
errToken: Meta refused NIVO's access. Log in with Facebook again.
errPermission: Meta did not allow this. Log in again and allow every permission, or check that you are an admin of the Page.
errRate: Meta is limiting requests right now. Please wait a minute and try again.
errNetwork: Could not reach Meta. Please check the connection and try again.
errGeneric: Something went wrong with Meta. Please try again.
